cost_leadership.title: Supply chain integration (RHP report)
cost_leadership.body: The Company operates a 'share and reuse' (pooling) model under which ownership and management of the Assets sits with the Company and is provided to customers as a service, enabling customers to operate an asset-light model by hiring and de-hiring Assets. According to the F&S Report, the Company operates a full-service model covering warehousing and distribution of returnable packaging Assets. Upstream, pallets are made with 100% SPF sourced from certified, sustainable international suppliers from Europe and Oceanic countries, and FSC certified SPF is used; the top ten suppliers and service providers contributed 60.00% of total purchases in Fiscal 2025. Downstream, as of May 31, 2025 the Company has 13.57 million Assets and maintains a pan-India network of 7,747 customer touchpoints and 30 fulfilment centres, which facilitate storage, maintenance, repair and rapid deployment of Assets; the extensive pan-India network enables the Company to leverage reverse logistics for pallet retrieval at a competitive cost. Maintenance and repairs are handled by the Company's own quality and repairs team, on-site or offsite as applicable, and repair and maintenance programs are run to extend asset lifespan. Technology is in-house and integrated: the in-house developed MyLEAP platform provides customers an interface for order tracking and management, recent order details, swapping damaged Assets, reports and support; SAP S/4HANA and Salesforce Management are integrated to enable electronic data interchange with customers; passive RFID technology is used to monitor containers through the supply chain; and IoT or passive RFID solutions are implemented in forklifts to track forklift movements at customer locations. In-house mobile and web applications include the RFID App, Asset Audit App, Transport Management System and Proof of Delivery (POD) App. The Company consolidated its position by acquiring 100% of the equity capital of CHEP India Private Limited on January 8, 2025, integrating CHEP India's established asset pooling network with its own and increasing its product portfolio, in particular in relation to the container business; TARON is the Company's subsidiary in forklift pooling. Product breadth spans pallets, containers and MHEs, allowing customers to deal with one partner rather than coordinating with multiple suppliers.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Customer relationships are typically long-term contractual agreements, with contracts typically multi-year recurring and select contracts ranging up to five years. The DRHP flags that if customers do not renew their agreements or expand the scope of services, or if relationships with top customers are impaired or terminated, business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows could be adversely impacted. The top 10 customers by Fiscal 2025 revenue contribution have each been with the Company for more than five years, concentrating renewal risk in a small set of accounts.
- The business requires continuous investment in pooled Assets (13.30 million in Fiscal 2025 from 6.93 million in Fiscal 2023). Debt to Equity rose to 0.87 times in Fiscal 2025 from 0.72 times in Fiscal 2024 and 0.62 times in Fiscal 2023. The Fresh Issue of ₹ 4,000.00 million is directed at repayment/prepayment of certain borrowings and general corporate purposes.
- Fiscal 2025 EBITDA margin was 56.45% but Return on Equity was only 4.60% and net profit ₹ 375.58 million, against Cash Return on Equity of 23.45% and Cash PAT of ₹ 1,912.87 million. The gap is the depreciation, amortisation and impairment charge on the pooled asset base, which the DRHP itself adds back in defining Cash PAT. Reported PAT is therefore highly sensitive to asset-life and impairment assumptions.
- CHEP India was acquired on January 8, 2025 and merged into the Company, so Fiscal 2025 restated results are not comparable with prior years. The DRHP explicitly warns that the Pro Forma Consolidated Financial Information is presented for illustrative purposes only and may not accurately reflect future financial condition, cash flows and results of operations. The routed extract is also internally inconsistent on the merger effective date (January 2, 2025 in 'Our Business' versus June 2, 2025 in 'Risk Factors' and 'MD&A').
- Per the F&S Report, India had only 15% palletization in CY2024 against 89% in North America, 91% in the EU, 94% in Australia and New Zealand and 50% in China, and India's pallet industry has only gained momentum and structure over the past 15 years. Growth is contingent on Indian customers converting from fragmented, manual handling to pooled palletized supply chains — a behavioural shift outside the Company's control.
- Revenue is a function of how much of the owned pool is deployed at customer locations. Container utilization was 76.03% and MHE utilization 81.54% in Fiscal 2025, leaving idle-asset drag; pallet utilization has been effectively flat at 87.46%, 87.75% and 87.85% across Fiscals 2025, 2024 and 2023, so incremental revenue must come from asset additions rather than utilization gains on the pallet pool.
- Promoters hold 391,393,072 equity shares of face value of ₹1 each, constituting 95.28% of the pre-Offer issued, subscribed and paid-up equity share capital on a fully diluted basis. Of the ₹ 24,000.00 million Offer, ₹ 20,000.00 million is an Offer for Sale (₹ 19,986.23 million by the KKR-affiliated Corporate Promoter Vertical Holdings II Pte. Ltd.) from which the Company receives no proceeds; only ₹ 4,000.00 million is a Fresh Issue.
- The market-leadership and market-size claims throughout the DRHP derive from the F&S Report, which was prepared exclusively for the Offer and commissioned and paid for by the Company for an agreed fee; the DRHP itself carries a dedicated risk factor stating that reliance on such information is subject to inherent risks. Separately, the Individual Promoter Sunu Mathew is simultaneously Chairman, Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer, and the DRHP's strengths section leans on his over-26-year career in the pallet industry.
